series.description: 日常生活、職場、料理、旅遊、產品發佈與居家改造的跟讀短文。放入對應 MP3 後即可真人跟讀。

articles.summaryZh: 從賴床、通勤、午間到收工入睡——日常節奏口語。

segments.en: I'll hit snooze just one more time.
segments.zh: 我再貪睡一下就好。

segments.en: I feel like staying in bed forever today.
segments.zh: 我今天好想賴在床上一輩子。

segments.en: Looks like it's pouring rain outside.
segments.zh: 外頭看起來在下大雨。

segments.en: I don't know if I can catch the 8:30 bus.
segments.zh: 我不知道還趕不趕得上八點半那班公車。

segments.en: I'm gonna grab an iced latte on my way to work.
segments.zh: 我上班路上會去買杯冰拿鐵。

segments.en: Let me quickly scan through my unread emails first.
segments.zh: 我先快速掃過未讀郵件。

segments.en: I wanna knock out this report before lunchtime.
segments.zh: 我想在午飯前把這份報告搞定。

segments.en: I have to wrap up this phone call with the client.
segments.zh: 我得先結束跟客戶的這通電話。

segments.en: Can I get a chicken salad to go, please?
segments.zh: 麻煩給我一份雞肉沙拉外帶，謝謝。

segments.en: Do you wanna take a quick walk to fight the food coma?
segments.zh: 要不要走走消食，趕走飯後昏睡？

segments.en: Could you double-check these numbers for me real quick?
segments.zh: 可以幫我再快速核對一下這些數字嗎？

segments.en: What do you say we pack up and call it a day?
segments.zh: 我們收拾一下收工，好不好？

segments.en: How do you usually unwind after such a stressful day?
segments.zh: 這麼高壓的一天後，你通常怎麼放鬆？

segments.en: I've been binge-watching this new show all evening.
segments.zh: 我整晚都在狂追這部新劇。

segments.en: I keep dozing off, so it's time for bed.
segments.zh: 我一直打瞌睡，該上床睡了。

articles.summaryZh: 專案目標、分工、延期與收尾——職場推進常用句。

segments.en: Let me walk you through the goals of this new project.
segments.zh: 我來帶你過一遍這個新專案的目標。

segments.en: I'll take the lead on drafting the project scope.
segments.zh: 專案範圍草案我來主導。

segments.en: Do you wanna handle the vendor communication part?
segments.zh: 廠商溝通這塊你要不要負責？

segments.en: Make sure you set clear deadlines for each milestone.
segments.zh: 記得替每個里程碑訂清楚的截止日期。

segments.en: I have to double-check our available budget before we spend.
segments.zh: 花錢前我得再確認可用預算。

segments.en: I wanna keep everyone in the loop as we build this.
segments.zh: 推進過程中我想讓大家都掌握進度。

segments.en: Could you send over the technical specs by noon?
segments.zh: 中午前可以把技術規格寄過來嗎？

segments.en: Looks like we just hit a bottleneck with the database.
segments.zh: 看起來我們在資料庫這邊卡關了。

segments.en: I don't know why this server keeps throwing errors.
segments.zh: 我不懂為什麼這台伺服器一直報錯。

segments.en: Why don't we test an alternative workaround first?
segments.zh: 不如我們先試試替代的變通方案？

segments.en: How do you feel about shifting the deadline back by two days?
segments.zh: 你覺得把截止日期延後兩天怎麼樣？

segments.en: I feel like that would give us enough breathing room.
segments.zh: 我覺得那樣會讓我們有足夠喘息空間。

segments.en: Are you sure the revised mockups are ready for presentation?
segments.zh: 修訂後的稿真的準備好簡報了嗎？

segments.en: What do you think management will say about these numbers?
segments.zh: 你覺得管理層會怎麼看這些數字？

segments.en: Can I get your final approval on this slide deck?
segments.zh: 這份簡報可以請你做最終核准嗎？

segments.en: I'm gonna push the code to production tonight.
segments.zh: 我今晚會把程式推上正式環境。

segments.en: I keep refreshing the analytics dashboard to check user feedback.
segments.zh: 我一直在重新整理分析儀表板看使用者回饋。

segments.en: I've been compiling all the bugs that users reported.
segments.zh: 我一直在彙整使用者回報的所有錯誤。

segments.en: How about running a quick retrospective on Friday afternoon?
segments.zh: 週五下午做個快速檢討會如何？

segments.en: It's time to archive the files and celebrate our win.
segments.zh: 是時候封存檔案、慶祝這次勝利了。

articles.summaryZh: 煎牛排與品嚐回饋——廚房場景口語與感官描述。

segments.en: I wanna try making authentic garlic butter steak tonight.
segments.zh: 今晚我想試試做道地的蒜香奶油牛排。

segments.en: Can I get two thick-cut ribeye steaks from the butcher?
segments.zh: 可以跟肉販買兩塊厚切肋眼牛排嗎？

segments.en: Don't forget to pat the beef completely dry with paper towels.
segments.zh: 別忘了用紙巾把牛肉徹底拍乾。

segments.en: Make sure you season both sides generously with coarse sea salt.
segments.zh: 記得兩面都要慷慨地撒上粗海鹽。

segments.en: I'll chop up some fresh rosemary and smash a few garlic cloves.
segments.zh: 我會剁一點新鮮迷迭香，再拍碎幾瓣蒜。

segments.en: I have to get this cast-iron skillet ripping hot first.
segments.zh: 我得先把這口鑄鐵鍋燒到超熱。

segments.en: All you need to do is sear the meat for two minutes without touching it.
segments.zh: 你只要把肉煎兩分鐘、中間別去動它。

segments.en: Looks like we've got a gorgeous golden-brown crust forming.
segments.zh: 看起來漂亮的金棕色外皮正在成形。

segments.en: Let me toss in a generous slab of butter for basting.
segments.zh: 我加一大塊奶油進去做澆淋。

segments.en: I'm gonna let the steak rest for five minutes before slicing.
segments.zh: 切片前我會讓牛排靜置五分鐘。

segments.en: It's time to dig in while everything is piping hot!
segments.zh: 趁一切滾燙熱騰騰，開動吧！

segments.en: There's no way home cooking can smell this incredible.
segments.zh: 家常料理怎麼可能香成這樣。

segments.en: Do you wanna take the first slice and try it?
segments.zh: 要不要先切第一片試試看？

segments.en: How do you like the doneness of this cut?
segments.zh: 你覺得這塊的熟度怎麼樣？

segments.en: It tastes like something served in a high-end steakhouse.
segments.zh: 吃起來像高級牛排館端出來的。

segments.en: You should definitely try it with this creamy peppercorn sauce.
segments.zh: 你一定要配這個奶油胡椒醬試試。

segments.en: I don't know how you got the meat so unbelievably tender.
segments.zh: 我不懂你怎麼把肉弄得這麼不可思議地嫩。

segments.en: Is it just me, or is the rosemary aroma coming through so cleanly?
segments.zh: 是只有我這樣覺得，還是迷迭香香氣真的很乾淨清楚？

segments.en: I feel like the garlic butter creates such a velvety mouthfeel.
segments.zh: 我覺得蒜香奶油帶來一種絲滑的口感。

segments.en: What do you think about pairing this with that dry red wine?
segments.zh: 你覺得搭配那瓶乾紅怎麼樣？

segments.en: How about a squeeze of lemon to cut through the richness?
segments.zh: 擠點檸檬來解膩如何？

segments.en: Why don't we mop up the leftover pan juices with that sourdough bread?
segments.zh: 不如用那塊酸種麵包把鍋汁沾光？

segments.en: Are you sure this is your first time nailing a medium-rare like this?
segments.zh: 你確定這是你第一次把五分熟抓得這麼準？

segments.en: I can't get over how crispy the edges are while the inside stays juicy.
segments.zh: 外緣這麼脆、裡面又多汁，我真的好驚豔。

segments.en: I've been craving a meal like this for the longest time.
segments.zh: 我渴望這樣一餐好久了。

segments.en: I keep reaching for more of these roasted potatoes on the side.
segments.zh: 我一直伸手去夾旁邊的烤馬鈴薯。

segments.en: If you ask me, this entire dinner is an absolute ten out of ten.
segments.zh: 要問我的話，這頓晚餐絕對一百分。

segments.en: Could you share your secret marinade recipe with me?
segments.zh: 可以把你的祕密醃料配方分享給我嗎？

segments.en: I'm so glad we decided to cook at home instead of eating out.
segments.zh: 好慶幸我們決定在家煮，而不是外食。

segments.en: Next time, let's make a bigger batch so we can have leftovers!
segments.zh: 下次我們做多一點，好留剩菜！

articles.summaryZh: 訂票、轉機、在地探索與旅途轉折——旅行全程口語。

segments.en: I wanna book the early flight to avoid morning turbulence.
segments.zh: 我想訂早班機，避開早上的亂流。

segments.en: Let me double-check all passport expiration dates first.
segments.zh: 我先再確認所有護照效期。

segments.en: Make sure you pack an international power adapter in your carry-on.
segments.zh: 記得在隨身行李放一個國際轉接頭。

segments.en: Don't forget to notify the credit card company about overseas transactions.
segments.zh: 別忘了通知信用卡公司有海外消費。

segments.en: I'll take care of the airport transfer reservation.
segments.zh: 機場接送預約交給我。

segments.en: Can I get a window seat closer to the front, please?
segments.zh: 可以給我靠前一點的靠窗座位嗎？

segments.en: Looks like our connecting flight has been delayed by two hours.
segments.zh: 看起來我們的轉機班機延誤了兩小時。

segments.en: I don't know if our checked luggage will make the tight transfer.
segments.zh: 不知道託運行李趕不趕得上這趟緊湊轉機。

segments.en: Could you check with the gate agent about hotel vouchers?
segments.zh: 可以跟閘口地勤問一下飯店住宿券嗎？

segments.en: I'm gonna grab a bottle of water before the stores close.
segments.zh: 商店打烊前我先去買瓶水。

segments.en: Do you wanna split a cab to the hotel instead of taking the train?
segments.zh: 要不要分攤計程車去飯店，別搭火車？

segments.en: What do you think about grabbing a bite at that 24-hour diner?
segments.zh: 去那間二十四小時小餐館吃一口，你覺得呢？

segments.en: How do you pronounce the name of this local street food?
segments.zh: 這個在地小吃的名字怎麼念？

segments.en: I feel like a good night's rest will cure this jet lag completely.
segments.zh: 我覺得好好睡一晚就能徹底治好時差。

segments.en: I keep checking my watch because my internal clock is totally off.
segments.zh: 我一直看錶，因為生理時鐘完全亂掉了。

segments.en: Why don't we hire a local guide for the historic quarter tomorrow?
segments.zh: 明天何不請個在地導遊逛歷史街區？

segments.en: How about renting electric scooters to explore the coastline?
segments.zh: 租電動滑板車去海岸線探險如何？

segments.en: Are you sure the temple is still open to visitors this late?
segments.zh: 你確定寺廟這麼晚還開放參觀嗎？

segments.en: It's time to exchange some local currency for the street stalls.
segments.zh: 該換點當地貨幣好逛街頭攤販了。

segments.en: I've been dying to try this Michelin-recommended pastry shop.
segments.zh: 我超想去這家米其林推薦的糕點店。

segments.en: All you need to do is scan this QR code to download the subway map.
segments.zh: 你只要掃這個 QR code 下載地鐵圖就行。

segments.en: There's no way we can hit all three museums in a single afternoon.
segments.zh: 一個下午不可能逛完三間博物館。

segments.en: You should definitely wear comfortable walking shoes on this cobblestone road.
segments.zh: 走這條石板路一定要穿舒服的走路鞋。

segments.en: Is it just me, or is the temperature dropping really fast tonight?
segments.zh: 是只有我覺得，還是今晚氣溫降得好快？

segments.en: It tastes like lemongrass and coconut milk blended together.
segments.zh: 吃起來像香茅和椰奶混在一起。

segments.en: I can't get over how well-preserved these ancient fortress walls are.
segments.zh: 這些古城牆保存得這麼好，我真的好驚豔。

segments.en: If you ask me, the view from the rooftop beats the crowded observatory.
segments.zh: 要問我的話，屋頂景觀比擁擠的觀景台好多了。

segments.en: I'm so glad we packed rain ponchos just in case.
segments.zh: 好慶幸我們以防萬一帶了雨衣。

segments.en: To be honest, the famous tourist trap wasn't worth the hype at all.
segments.zh: 老實說，那個有名的觀光陷阱完全不值得炒作。

segments.en: No wonder all the locals lined up outside this tiny alley bakery.
segments.zh: 難怪當地人都在這間小巷麵包店外排隊。

segments.en: I'm afraid that the ferry service might be suspended due to rough seas.
segments.zh: 恐怕渡輪會因為海況不佳而停駛。

segments.en: Chances are we can catch the sunset if we take the bypass route now.
segments.zh: 如果現在走便道，很有機會趕上日落。

segments.en: Assuming that the traffic clears up, we'll reach the station by five.
segments.zh: 假設交通疏通，我們五點前可以到車站。

segments.en: Even if it starts drizzling, the market still has an indoor pavilion.
segments.zh: 就算下起毛毛雨，市場也還有室內亭區。

segments.en: What if we take the scenic mountain train back instead of flying?
segments.zh: 萬一我們改搭景觀山列車回去、不搭飛機呢？

segments.en: It turns out that the landmark was closed for renovation on Tuesdays.
segments.zh: 原來這個地標星期二會因整修關閉。

segments.en: I couldn't help but take hundreds of photos of that incredible sunset.
segments.zh: 那個驚人的日落，我忍不住拍了上百張。

segments.en: I'm looking forward to soaking in the hotel hot tub after all this hiking.
segments.zh: 走了這麼多路，我很期待泡飯店的熱水浴缸。

segments.en: Next time, we should definitely spend at least three nights in this quaint town.
segments.zh: 下次我們一定要在這個古雅小鎮至少住三晚。

segments.en: Looking back on it, that missed train turned out to be our best adventure.
segments.zh: 回想起來，錯過那班火車反而是我們最棒的冒險。

articles.summaryZh: 從路線圖、彩排到上線檢討——發佈會全週期職場口語。

segments.en: Let me outline the strategic roadmap for this Q4 product launch.
segments.zh: 我來概述這次第四季產品發布的策略路線圖。

segments.en: First off, we must establish clear performance indicators for the rollout.
segments.zh: 首先，我們必須為上線訂出清楚的績效指標。

segments.en: Make sure you finalize the press release before forwarding it to legal.
segments.zh: 轉給法務前，請先把新聞稿定稿。

segments.en: Don't forget to loop in the customer support team for crisis training.
segments.zh: 別忘了把客服團隊拉進來做危機訓練。

segments.en: I'll oversee the coordination between engineering and marketing.
segments.zh: 工程與行銷之間的協調我來督導。

segments.en: I wanna clarify the user onboarding flow during the live demo.
segments.zh: 現場示範時我想把使用者導覽流程講清楚。

segments.en: Could you pull the latest analytics on user sign-ups from beta?
segments.zh: 可以拉一下測試版最新的註冊分析嗎？

segments.en: I have to stress the importance of server stability under high traffic.
segments.zh: 我必須強調高流量下伺服器穩定的重要性。

segments.en: Can I get a status report on the API gateway integration by noon?
segments.zh: 中午前可以給我 API 閘道整合的進度報告嗎？

segments.en: Looks like the design department revised the brand assets again.
segments.zh: 看來設計部門又改了品牌素材。

segments.en: I don't know whether the current bandwidth can handle ten thousand users.
segments.zh: 我不確定目前頻寬能不能撐一萬名使用者。

segments.en: Why don't we set up a backup server cluster to prevent sudden crashes?
segments.zh: 何不建置備援伺服器叢集，預防突然當機？

segments.en: Do you wanna rehearse the keynote slides on the main stage tomorrow?
segments.zh: 明天要不要在主舞台彩排主題簡報？

segments.en: What do you say about inviting tech journalists for an exclusive early look?
segments.zh: 邀請科技記者搶先獨家體驗，你覺得呢？

segments.en: How do you plan to handle negative press if the feature receives backlash?
segments.zh: 如果功能引發反彈，你打算怎麼處理負面報導？

segments.en: I feel like the pricing tier might be slightly confusing to casual users.
segments.zh: 我覺得收費方案對一般使用者可能有點難懂。

segments.en: Are you sure all data privacy compliance standards have been satisfied?
segments.zh: 你確定所有資料隱私合規標準都達標了嗎？

segments.en: How about streamlining the registration process to just two simple clicks?
segments.zh: 把註冊流程精簡成兩次點擊如何？

segments.en: All you need to do is approve the budget reallocation for targeted paid ads.
segments.zh: 你只要核准定向付費廣告的預算重分配就行。

segments.en: There's no way we can delay the release date with media invites already out.
segments.zh: 媒體邀請都已發出，發布日不可能再延。

segments.en: You should definitely dry-run the payment gateway with international cards.
segments.zh: 你一定要用國際卡對支付閘道做一次彩排測試。

segments.en: Is it just me, or does this dashboard look slightly cluttered on mobile?
segments.zh: 是只有我覺得，還是這個儀表板在手機上看有點雜？

segments.en: I can't get over how responsive the interface feels after the optimization.
segments.zh: 優化後介面這麼跟手，我真的好驚豔。

segments.en: If you ask me, this killer feature alone will disrupt the entire market.
segments.zh: 要問我的話，光這個殺手鐧功能就會顛覆整個市場。

segments.en: I'm gonna trigger the deployment script as soon as you give the word.
segments.zh: 你一點頭，我就會啟動部署腳本。

segments.en: It's time to open the registration portal to the public waiting list.
segments.zh: 是時候對公開候補名單開放註冊入口了。

segments.en: I keep watching the error logs to make sure nothing unexpected spikes.
segments.zh: 我一直盯著錯誤日誌，確保沒有異常暴衝。

segments.en: I've been tracking the real-time conversion rates every ten minutes.
segments.zh: 我每十分鐘都在追即時轉換率。

segments.en: To be honest, the initial server load was heavier than we anticipated.
segments.zh: 老實說，初期伺服器負載比我們預期更重。

segments.en: No wonder our social media mentions skyrocketed after the live stream.
segments.zh: 難怪直播後社群提及量暴衝。

segments.en: I'm afraid that the free tier users are hitting the system capacity limit.
segments.zh: 恐怕免費用戶正在撞上系統容量上限。

segments.en: Chances are enterprise clients will ask for customized API solutions.
segments.zh: 企業客戶很有可能要求客製化 API 方案。

segments.en: Assuming that the current retention rate holds, we will hit our target.
segments.zh: 假設目前留存率維持得住，我們會達標。

segments.en: Even if competitors copy the concept, our ecosystem lock-in is stronger.
segments.zh: 就算對手抄概念，我們的生態系黏著度更強。

segments.en: What if we offer a launch discount to convert trial users to yearly plans?
segments.zh: 若提供上市優惠，把試用者轉成年繳方案呢？

segments.en: It turns out that the micro-influencer campaign generated the best ROI.
segments.zh: 原來微型網紅活動帶來了最佳投資報酬率。

segments.en: I'm so glad the dev team patched that critical security leak overnight.
segments.zh: 好慶幸開發團隊連夜修了那個關鍵資安漏洞。

segments.en: Correct me if I'm wrong, but didn't we promise dark mode by next week?
segments.zh: 若我說錯請糾正，但我們不是承諾下週有深色模式嗎？

segments.en: I see your point, but scaling back features now would hurt our credibility.
segments.zh: 我懂你的意思，但現在砍功能會傷害可信度。

segments.en: As far as I know, the board members are thrilled with the first-day results.
segments.zh: 就我所知，董事會對首日成果相當興奮。

segments.en: As long as you keep the uptime above ninety-nine percent, clients stay happy.
segments.zh: 只要你把可用率維持在百分之九十九以上，客戶就會開心。

segments.en: Unless we optimize the database queries, operational costs will balloon.
segments.zh: 除非我們優化資料庫查詢，否則營運成本會膨脹。

segments.en: Just to make sure, did everyone update their documentation on GitHub?
segments.zh: 只是再確認一下，大家都在 GitHub 更新文件了嗎？

segments.en: Speaking of which, has the marketing team scheduled the follow-up emails?
segments.zh: 說到這，行銷團隊排好後續郵件了嗎？

segments.en: At this rate, we are projected to double our daily active users by Friday.
segments.zh: 照這個速度，預估週五前日活躍用戶會翻倍。

segments.en: There is no doubt that this rollout set a new benchmark for the company.
segments.zh: 毫無疑問，這次上線為公司立下新標竿。

segments.en: The bottom line is user retention matters far more than vanity metrics.
segments.zh: 重點是：使用者留存遠比虛榮指標重要。

segments.en: In retrospect, conducting those two extra dry runs saved us from disaster.
segments.zh: 事後看來，多做那兩次彩排讓我們免於災難。

segments.en: It goes without saying that the entire team deserves a huge bonus for this.
segments.zh: 不用說，整個團隊都該為這次拿豐厚獎金。

segments.en: Next time, we should automate the regression testing pipeline even earlier.
segments.zh: 下次我們該更早把回歸測試管線自動化。

articles.summaryZh: 拆除、水電、智慧設備到入住——居家改造現場口語。

segments.en: I feel like this 40-year-old townhouse has incredible potential.
segments.zh: 我覺得這棟四十年連棟透天潛力驚人。

segments.en: First off, we need a structural engineer to inspect the load-bearing walls.
segments.zh: 首先，我們需要結構工程師檢查承重牆。

segments.en: Make sure you obtain all the necessary renovation permits from city hall.
segments.zh: 記得向市政廳取得所有必要的翻修許可。

segments.en: Don't forget to turn off the main water and gas valves before demolition.
segments.zh: 拆除前別忘了關閉總水閥與瓦斯閥。

segments.en: I'll negotiate the scope and terms with the general contractor.
segments.zh: 工程範圍與條款我會跟總承包商談。

segments.en: I wanna knock down this dividing partition to create an open kitchen.
segments.zh: 我想打掉這道隔間牆，做成開放式廚房。

segments.en: Let me review the electrical blueprint for all the smart switches.
segments.zh: 我來檢視所有智慧開關的電氣藍圖。

segments.en: Could you ensure every socket in the kitchen has proper grounding?
segments.zh: 可以確認廚房每個插座都有妥善接地嗎？

segments.en: I have to stick to our budget limits, or we'll run out of cash.
segments.zh: 我得守住預算上限，否則會手頭吃緊。

segments.en: Can I get an itemized estimate for replacing the corroded galvanized pipes?
segments.zh: 更換腐蝕鍍鋅管可以給我明細報價嗎？

segments.en: Looks like the roof has a chronic seepage problem around the corners.
segments.zh: 看起來屋頂角落有長期滲水問題。

segments.en: I don't know if these vintage floor tiles can be salvaged intact.
segments.zh: 不知道這些復古地磚能不能完整搶救下來。

segments.en: Why don't we run neutral wires into every gang box for smart relays?
segments.zh: 何不把中性線拉進每個接線盒，方便智慧繼電器？

segments.en: Do you wanna install a centralized water filtration unit in the basement?
segments.zh: 要不要在地下室裝中央淨水設備？

segments.en: What do you think of using soundproof double-glazed windows facing the avenue?
segments.zh: 臨大街那側用隔音雙層玻璃窗，你覺得呢？

segments.en: How do you want to configure the automated lighting scenes in the living room?
segments.zh: 客廳自動化燈光情境你想怎麼設定？

segments.en: Are you sure the current circuit breaker can handle a high-power induction cooktop?
segments.zh: 你確定現有斷路器撐得住高功率IH爐嗎？

segments.en: How about concealing all the ethernet cabling inside the skirting boards?
segments.zh: 把所有網路線藏進踢腳板裡如何？

segments.en: All you need to do is pick out the paint swatch for the master bedroom.
segments.zh: 你只要挑好主臥的油漆色卡就行。

segments.en: There's no way we can live on site while they are jackhammering the floors.
segments.zh: 他們用破碎機打地板時，我們不可能住現場。

segments.en: You should definitely pressure-test the new plumbing before closing up the drywall.
segments.zh: 封石膏板前一定要對新水管做壓力測試。

segments.en: Is it just me, or does this custom cabinetry seem two inches too shallow?
segments.zh: 是只有我覺得，還是這組訂製櫃體淺了兩吋？

segments.en: I can't get over how much brighter the interior feels with skylights installed.
segments.zh: 裝了天窗後室內亮這麼多，我真的好驚豔。

segments.en: If you ask me, matte black hardware looks way classier than polished chrome.
segments.zh: 要問我的話，霧黑五金比拋光鉻雅緻多了。

segments.en: I'm gonna set up the Zigbee smart hub right in the middle of the hallway.
segments.zh: 我會把 Zigbee 智慧中樞裝在走廊正中央。

segments.en: It's time to pair all the motorized shades with the voice assistant.
segments.zh: 是時候把所有電動窗簾跟語音助理配對了。

segments.en: I keep finding fine drywall dust settling on newly delivered furniture.
segments.zh: 我一直發現石膏粉塵落在剛送來的家具上。

segments.en: I've been vacuuming the air filters every single day during sanding.
segments.zh: 打磨期間我每天都在吸空氣濾網。

segments.en: To be honest, the marble countertop price quote gave me sticker shock.
segments.zh: 老實說，大理石檯面報價讓我價格休克。

segments.en: No wonder the renovation took two weeks longer than originally scheduled.
segments.zh: 難怪翻修比原訂時程多花了兩週。

segments.en: I'm afraid that the tiles in the guest bath weren't leveled properly.
segments.zh: 恐怕客房浴室的磁磚沒有整平好。

segments.en: Chances are the contractor will have to rip out those three uneven slabs.
segments.zh: 承包商很有可能得拆掉那三片不平的板。

segments.en: Assuming that the silicone sealant dries by tomorrow, we can test the shower.
segments.zh: 假設矽利康明天乾了，我們就能測淋浴。

segments.en: Even if the power cuts out, the smart lock has an emergency USB-C terminal.
segments.zh: 就算停電，智慧鎖也有緊急 USB-C 接孔。

segments.en: What if we automate the exhaust fans to turn on when humidity exceeds 70%?
segments.zh: 若濕度超過百分之七十就自動開抽風機呢？

segments.en: It turns out that the original subfloor was completely infested with dry rot.
segments.zh: 原來原本的底層地板整個被乾腐菌侵蝕。

segments.en: I'm so glad we replaced all the aging wiring with flame-retardant cables.
segments.zh: 好慶幸我們把老化線路全換成耐燃電纜。

segments.en: Correct me if I'm wrong, but didn't we agree that dimmers were included in the price?
segments.zh: 若我說錯請糾正，但我們不是說好調光器含在報價裡嗎？

segments.en: I see your point, but safety always trumps aesthetics when it comes to electricity.
segments.zh: 我懂你的意思，但談到電力，安全永遠優先於美觀。

segments.en: As far as I know, the warranty covers any roof leaks for the next five years.
segments.zh: 就我所知，保固涵蓋未來五年任何屋頂漏水。

segments.en: As long as you maintain the HVAC filters quarterly, the efficiency stays peak.
segments.zh: 只要你每季保養空調濾網，效率就能維持巔峰。

segments.en: Unless we seal the grout, stains will permanently ruin the kitchen backsplash.
segments.zh: 除非我們封好填縫劑，否則汙漬會永久毀了廚房背牆。

segments.en: Just to make sure, did the carpenter leave access panels for the air conditioning?
segments.zh: 只是再確認，木工有留空調維修口嗎？

segments.en: Speaking of which, the customized solid wood dining table arrives on Thursday.
segments.zh: 說到這，訂製實木餐桌星期四會到。

segments.en: At this rate, we will finally be able to sleep in our own bed by the weekend.
segments.zh: 照這個速度，週末我們終於能睡自己的床了。

segments.en: There is no doubt that surviving a major renovation tests any relationship.
segments.zh: 毫無疑問，熬過大翻修是對任何關係的考驗。

segments.en: The bottom line is the structural integrity of the home has been completely restored.
segments.zh: 重點是：房子的結構完整性已徹底恢復。

segments.en: In retrospect, choosing waterproof vinyl planks over real hardwood was brilliant.
segments.zh: 事後看來，選防水塑膠地板而非實木地板太明智了。

segments.en: It goes without saying that hosting the housewarming party is going to be a blast.
segments.zh: 不用說，辦喬遷派對一定會超好玩。

segments.en: It's about time we peeled off the protective plastic films and enjoyed the space.
segments.zh: 是時候撕掉保護膠膜、好好享受這個空間了。

segments.en: The thing is, smart home automation is only as good as your home network.
segments.zh: 重點是：智慧家居再強，也取決於你家的網路。

segments.en: I'd rather invest upfront in commercial-grade routers than suffer spotty Wi-Fi.
segments.zh: 我寧願一開始投資商用級路由器，也不要忍受不穩的 Wi-Fi。

segments.en: Believe it or not, the automated routines already cut down our utility bills.
segments.zh: 信不信由你，自動化情境已經降低我們的公用事業費。

segments.en: There's no point in buying fancy gadgets if they can't integrate into one app.
segments.zh: 若不能整合進同一個 App，買炫砲裝置就沒意義。

segments.en: Except for the fact that the doorbell camera is overly sensitive, everything works great.
segments.zh: 除了門鈴攝影機過度敏感之外，一切都很順利。

segments.en: For the time being, let's leave the guest room empty until we decide on the furniture.
segments.zh: 暫時先讓客房空著，等我們決定家具再說。

segments.en: In the meantime, we can set up the entertainment center and mount the TV.
segments.zh: 同時我們可以架娛樂中心、把電視掛上牆。

segments.en: Hardly had we unpacked the last moving box when the neighbors knocked with cookies.
segments.zh: 我們幾乎還沒拆完最後一個紙箱，鄰居就帶著餅乾來敲門。

segments.en: No matter how exhausting the messy demolition phase was, the outcome is stunning.
segments.zh: 無論凌亂的拆除階段多累人，成果都令人驚豔。

segments.en: Next time, whenever we tackle a home project, we'll know exactly how to manage it.
segments.zh: 下次再做居家專案，我們就會完全知道怎麼管理。
